lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: US-002's in-process gate behaviour has no committed regression test.

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 (round-1 review CRITICAL finding on CAM-488) added test/check-all-inprocess-gates.test.ts, driving the REAL coverageGate/skipRatchetGate pulled off the GATES manifest (never re-implemented) against a real mkdtemp'd fixture cwd (scripts/coverage-budget.json + test/helpers/lane-expectations.json). Covers: (1) runGates threads the captured blob into gate.run verbatim exactly once (a synthetic recording in-process gate, no fixture needed); (2) empty blob fails both real in-process gates closed; (3) a healthy floor-met/lane-matched blob makes both pass (the positive control that proves the blob is really threaded, not silently dropped to ''); (4) a below-floor coverage blob fails coverage while skip-ratchet still passes independently from the same blob; (5) the three skip-ratchet failure modes (crashed/no-completion-tally, below passFloor, skip-count mismatch) driven straight through skipRatchetGate.run; (6) anti-contamination -- a failing 'test' spawn gate (exitCode 1) does not flip the coverage/skip-ratchet verdicts, which are derived purely from blob content. IMPORTANT GOTCHA hit and fixed during this story (also recorded in patterns.md): any test that drives runGates through the real 'test' spawn gate with a REALISTIC blob (containing 'Ran N tests across M files.'/' N pass'/' N skip'/'All files | x | y' lines matching check-all.ts's own regexes) MUST silence process.stdout/stderr for that call (withSilentStdio helper, stub .write to a no-op, restore in finally) -- captureAndEchoSuiteOutput unconditionally echoes the 'test' gate's buffers to the REAL stdout/stderr, and since this test file runs inside the repo's own bun test --coverage when bun run check:all gates itself, an un-silenced echo leaks fabricated pass/skip/coverage numbers into the OUTER check-all run's real captured blob (first-match regex wins, so fake numbers shadow real ones). Caught live: an un-silenced version of these tests made bun run check:all fail with 'observed 160 pass, below recorded passFloor 5500' -- 160 was the test's OWN fixture number. Full spine verified green AFTER the withSilentStdio fix: bun run typecheck (0 errors), bun test (5951 pass / 0 fail), bun run check:all (exit 0, all 14 gates ok, no contamination). Two more round-1 findings remain in prd.json as separate stories: US-R1-002 (WARNING: an exception thrown by an in-process gate's run fn escapes runGates unguarded and aborts the whole spine -- wrap gate.run in try/catch in executeGate/runInProcessGate) and US-R1-003 (WARNING: test/check-all.test.ts's file header still claims 'no real subprocess is invoked', which is now false for the three full-manifest tests that exercise the real coverage gate's real git diff + real budget/expectations file reads -- restate the header or pass an explicit spawn-only gates array to those three tests). Neither was in scope for this story (US-R1-001 only).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure test-addition story: no new external library surface, only bun:test + node:fs (mkdtempSync/mkdirSync/writeFileSync/rmSync) already used identically elsewhere in the suite (e.g. test/issue-list.test.ts) and process.stdout/stderr.write stubbing already used identically elsewhere (test/issue-dispatch.test.ts's withSilentStderr).
